name: With rugs: the RÅDMANSÖ king on the bathroom wall with a RÅDMANSÖ nightstand on each side under matching wall lamps, the TIOKRONA under the bed
notes:
With rugs, the alternative since the evening of 2026-10-26 (Andrew: rugless, "wife wins"): a's room with the TIOKRONA under the bed, re-staged with a later that evening on his word ("the 2 nightsandsa need to be on each side of the bed, the door opens inwards towrds hte bathroom. We don't need the samller nightstand. We don't nee dpoang chair in that room."). 10 placed, 12 extras.
A king fits one way only: headboard end on the right (bathroom) wall, between the heater's face (3" off the wall, F-33) and the bottom wall: 130" for two nightstands, the frame and the walk. With both RÅDMANSÖ (21 1/4" each along the wall) and the 79 1/8" frame, 2 3/8" are left: the window nightstand takes F-33's 6" off the heater's face, the bed stands at y 30.25-109.375, and the bathroom nightstand ends 2 3/8" short of the bottom wall. The bed's bathroom side is the walk to the bathroom, 23 5/8" wide (walkway-narrow:23.6; F-30 and F-31's landing by Andrew's word), and the bathroom door opens into the bathroom (Andrew, 2026-10-26), so nothing swings into it.
bed-1 RÅDMANSÖ king with the LURÖY base, brown walnut effect (floor): right wall, rot 90, x 89.625-177, y 30.25-109.375, its 76" mattress about y 31.8-107.8. F-34: the window side 27 1/4" from the heater's face to the frame beyond the nightstand (28 3/4" to the mattress), the way in for that sleeper; the bathroom side 23 5/8" from the frame to the bottom wall (25 1/8" from the mattress), the way in for the other and the walk to the bathroom (walkway-narrow:23.6). F-33: bedding 28 3/4" from the heater's face. Its sloped headboard (40 1/2") stands against the wall under the art; 7 7/8" under the frame. Its mattress is Andrew's Zinus Green Tea 12" king from Amazon.
nightstand-1 RÅDMANSÖ nightstand, 21 1/4x15 1/8x22 7/8" (floor): the window side of the head, rot 90, x 161.875-177, y 9-30.25, 6" off the heater's face (F-33) and against the frame; Andrew's. nightstand-2 RÅDMANSÖ (floor): the bathroom side of the head, rot 90, x 161.875-177, y 109.375-130.625, against the frame and 2 3/8" from the bottom wall; Eutine's. At the sketch's door position (8" from the corner, assumed-position:door) it stands in the doorway's hinge corner, 7" of the 30" door (x 161.9-169), so the door is entered through its other 23"; with the door 16" or more from the corner it clears the doorway. Both on legs with 12 5/8" under, a drawer and a shelf each, a cable slot for a charger (where the outlets are is still open). The planner's warnings `in front of the bathroom` for the bed and this nightstand stand on Andrew's word.
lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS bamboo wall lamps (top): on the head wall over the nightstands, x 172-177, y 16.9-23.9 and 115.75-122.75, mirrored about the bed's center line (y 69.8), about 24" above the mattress: a soft glow (5.9 W), bedside light, not a reading light (a swing-arm reading lamp for each side is still to find). Plug-in on a 7' 3" cord in a cover along the head wall to an outlet, never down past the heater. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide 55x22" (top): right wall over the bed, centered, x 176-177, y 42.3-97.3, 18.4" from each lamp; its bottom edge about 50" off the floor, 9 1/2" above the headboard, on two closed security hangers into anchors, since Maddie climbs on the bed (F-21). night-light-1 TÖVÄDER battery night light (top) on the bathroom nightstand, x 168-171, y 112-118, on its 8-hour timer: the glow for the night walk, no cord.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 7'10"x9'10" jute (rug): rot 0, x 40-158, y 22.8-116.8, centered on the bed's width: under its lower 68.4" (78%), 7.4" out on each side and 49.6" past the foot, 19.8" off the heater's face (F-33) and 16.2" short of the bottom wall; on two STOPP FILT underlays (extras). Its page says "Do not wash" and never a rotating brush. bench-1 PERJOHAN pine bench (floor): across the foot, rot 90, x 76.625-87.625, y 50.1-89.5, centered on the bed and 2" off its foot: a seat and blanket storage; pine reads orange against the honey-oak floor (the video, 2026-10-26), so it can wait or go.
plant-1 FEJKA areca palm (floor): on the floor in the window-side corner where the reading chair stood, x 1.5-6.25, y 15-19.75, 12" off the heater's face. storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor): left wall, rot 270, x 0-16.5, y 71.4-95: linens and towels, 8" above the door's swing (F-31, assumed-position:door), 8.7" beside the closet's landing, the open floor in front of its doors (F-32); anchor-required (F-21: 76"). Drawn, not ordered: Andrew will see the storage units in person on Saturday ("we are not getting the other storage units for this order idea, not sure I like those at the moent and will see it in person on saturday").
Walkways (F-30): from the door to the bathroom along the bottom of the room, 43.5" of open floor below the bench's lower end, then the bed's bathroom side, 23 5/8" to the door (walkway-narrow:23.6); 70" of open floor between the left wall and the bench up to the window side, and 47" between the bench's top end and the heater's face; the closet's 36" landing stays clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet).
Extras: the king's Zinus Green Tea 12" mattress x1 (Amazon, in a box, 24 to 72 hours to expand; F-22 does not apply), DVALA King sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE King insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA King cover set x1, VILDKORN Queen pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window), STOPP FILT underlays x2 under the TIOKRONA, and the PURRPINGLA laundry bag x1 in the walk-in closet.
Not placed: the VIHALS nightstand and the LACK wall shelf (two RÅDMANSÖ instead, Andrew's word); the POÄNG reading chair, its TÅGARP and the LACK side table ("We don't need POÄNG chair in that room"); a dresser (the walk-in closet holds the clothes; the STORKLINTA is in b to g); the NISSEDAL mirror (glass, F-21); the Mellow king (i).
Total $1,996.77: placed $1,253.91 + extras $742.86; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-26 (those before today price-stale, F-02).
Flags across the layout: walkway-narrow:23.6 (the bed's bathroom side), assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (storage-1).
Move-in day (F-07, F-64): the right wall's 133" is derived from the left wall's. Tape it before the boxes are opened: at 133" as drawn; anything over 133" goes to the walk; under 130 5/8" the window nightstand moves to 3" off the heater's face; under 127 5/8" the bathroom nightstand comes off the wall (it has no other place in the room); under 127" the RÅDMANSÖ and the Zinus go back unopened and g, the MALM queen, is the plan. Tape the bathroom door's distance from the corner: 16" or more clears the doorway's corner.
History: staged 2026-10-24 (the Mellow king, F-64), re-staged 2026-10-25 (the 3" heater, the 30" landing), 2026-10-26 on Andrew's cart (the RÅDMANSÖ king), rugless that evening, and both nightstands at the bed later that evening ("the 2 nightsandsa need to be on each side of the bed, the door opens inwards towrds hte bathroom. We don't need the samller nightstand. We don't nee dpoang chair in that room.").
